A '''diagnostic chip''' was a piece of technology. [[Tromig]] fitted a diagnostic chip to a [[DL-22 blaster pistol]], which allowed an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] to run maintenance checks on the weapon.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
